chose: the ship sweep runs hourly, as one mutation that reads every member's progress and unlock rows and makes each shipped feature ready, with its DM intent, for members at or past its level who have none
over: a sweep every 5 or 15 minutes; a stored per-workspace marker of the features already swept; one scheduled mutation per member
because: #101: a flag flip raises no domain event. One deployment serves one workspace, so a full read of its members is a few hundred small documents; hourly that is 720 function calls and a few tens of MB of reads a month, far inside the free Convex plan's 1M calls and 1 GB, while 15 minutes quadruples both for a ship notice nobody waits on by the minute. A marker would be a new write whenever the flag goes off and on and would miss members who levelled up while it was off; per-member scheduling buys nothing at this size. The interval is one constant in convex/crons.ts
